intent_relevance.description: The reply understands what the comment is about.

game_grounding.description: Uses current-game context when needed and does not force a game reading onto an off-game comment.

evidence_discipline.description: Never invents a screen, state or past scene that was not available.

conversation_quality.description: Natural broadcast reply, not overly long.

factual_consistency.description: No assertion contradicting the input or available context.
